naming.rule: Every filename says WHERE it plays, WHAT it is, and WHICH CAST, in this order:  S<song>-<code>-<what>-<CAST>.<ext>   The cast tag is ML (Maegan & Landon), AC (Andrew & Charlie), or SHARED (one file serves both casts). The code (M2, M15, V2…) is the part the system reads — never change it; the rest is for humans.
naming.photos: JPG (convert HEIC). Long side at least 1600 px. Keep each file under 8 MB so it travels through the Drive connector.
naming.video: MP4 (H.264), 1920×1080 landscape. The video is larger than the Drive transfer limit: upload it to the GitHub repo (Add file → Upload files, into assets/) or give it to the show laptop — tell me which.
naming.folder: One Google Drive folder named  L5Y ASSETS , files flat inside it (no subfolders). Tell me when files land — I pull them and place every one by its code. A missing file keeps its placeholder, so partial uploads never break the show.
naming.loop: Every photo also falls in the preshow / intermission loop. Extra photos for the loop only: name them S00-LOOP-<what>-ML.jpg / -AC.jpg / -SHARED.jpg; up to ~30 total.

assets.title: Cathy's lock-screen wallpaper — a photo of Jamie
